resources.string: Online link protection
Check links against Google Safe Browsing threat information. Local message checks still run on this phone.

When enabled, this phone sends short URL hash prefixes to Google. Message text and complete URLs are not sent. Google can see your IP address and request metadata. Your key is encrypted on this phone.
Advisory provided by Google for Google-listed threats. Detection is not guaranteed. No match means no known threat was found, not that a link is safe.
This prototype uses the noncommercial Safe Browsing API. A commercial release needs an appropriately licensed service.
Online checks need a Safe Browsing API key. Add one in Protection settings.
Online checks are off. Only local checks are available.
Online checks are enabled. Each result shows whether its lookup completed.
Safe Browsing API key
Enable the Safe Browsing API in your Google Cloud project and restrict this key to that API. Never share the key in screenshots or messages.

Only the supplied link is checked. Short-link redirects and the final website are not opened or inspected.

Message text stays in memory and is never saved. Encrypted history on this phone keeps only risk results, domain names, times and reasons. Online checks send URL hash prefixes, not message bodies or full URLs.
Demo lab
